reviews.x: Love the natural scent. It’s very uplifting and wakes me up in the shower when I use it in the morning. Perfect for summer because it buffs your body leaving soft skin behind. The granules are not too rough and doesn’t tear up your skin.

I use this product in the shower before I wash my body. This product polishes my body as well as removes extra build up in places such as my underarms where my soap and towel needs a little assistance.

I like the feel of the product. It’s granulated nicely so it gives a good scrub but it’s not painfully abrasive. The smell is very nice and not overpowering. The only thing is that I wish it stayed together a bit more out of the container. Another scrub I used contained oil so the scrub was a bit easier to get out of the container without some of it falling out when you put your hand into it. But overall a nice Product that I will probably order again.

I needed a new body scrub and this had good reviews and I love grapefruit. So when I initially opened it, it was pretty dry. I tried to mix it a bit because the middle part was a bit more moist, which made a mess and a lot of the top layer of scrub spilled out. I added a bit of water to see if it helped, it was a bit better but not great. The scrub smells nice, but the formula, which I didn’t pay attention to has coconut oil in it, and was super greasy. It left a film on my skin that I had to us

reviews.t: Great scent and perfect for dry skin issues!
reviews.x: I bought this product for my super dry winter skin based on the reviews.  The scent is nice, kind of a floral grapefruit/citrus scent.  I have eczema and dry skin so I tried this on my upper arms first. It is wonderful!  Even the next morning after using at night, my skin still feels soft.  I’m going to use it all over and hopefully I’ll get the same results.  I do think this product is a little bit overpriced but the quality is comparable to high/end scrubs I’ve purchased at Ulta and Sephora.

reviews.t: Its okay, it just depends on your skin.
reviews.x: This is an okay body exfoliator. There's not much of a scent to it and it does exfoliate my skin nicely but I wont really use it. I felt like I just dumped a bunch of oil onto my skin. I gave this to my boyfriend since i didn't really like it but he loves it. He says he uses it for his face and beard. Says it makes his face feel soft and cleaner than just face wash. So it really depends on your skin.

reviews.t: Good salt scrub for the money
reviews.x: This is a good scrub for the money, not a huge quantity but decent compared to the ones where you get a few more ounces but they are 2x as much.  The texture is good, could have a bit more oil for moisturizing - also felt like the scent wasn’t as potent or citrusy as I would have liked.  I would buy it again as its not a bad scrub just not as good as some of the other more expensive ones.

I love a good body scrub! It has been hard for me to find the right one since most break me out due to having WAY too much coconut oil.  But this once has coconut oil as the last ingredient so its very light for me. I have been using only for a week but I am already in love with it.

reviews.t: Smells great but wish it had more oil
reviews.x: I normally buy salt scrubs because they also have some oil in them.  This one shows oil on the list of ingredients but there seems to be very little.  It smells great since I love grapefruit scent.  I probably won't buy again though over the oil issue.

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY IF YOU HAVE ECZEMA
reviews.x: This thing smells strongly artificial and is highly irritable if you have mild to severe eczema. Please stay away from it.  I got the Graprefuit one, use it on my body only, and it gave me an allergic reaction. I would not use it on my face ever!

I was looking for a sugar scrub to replace the one that Bath & Body Works discontinued. The scent is nice but there is little oil/other ingredients to allow it to apply easy as it falls apart like sand. I will not purchase this in the future.

I was disappointed in how little product you get from this. For the price and amount, it's expensive. I exfoliate once a week or so, and it lasted me a month. I also had to rinse it off VERY quick as it made me itch if I left it on too long.

I use this for laser and it is amazing. It moisturizes but also exfoliates and removes dead skin and hair well. It's not harsh and it smells amazing. I've subscribed and saved for it and it's one of the best decisions I've made. 5 stars.

Both my daughter and I tried this out right away. It’s fantastic!! Doesn’t leave a greasy film or feeling on skin, pleasant scent, and my skin feels incredible!! Definitely will become a part of my routine from now on. This is a keeper!

The product itself im sure is great, just that by the time it got to me, it was leaking all over the place and all the moisture was gone. I had to try and reconstitute it, with no luck. I feel it ended up being a total loss.

I purchased about 2 months ago or so and use 1-2 times a week head to toe. My skin feels amazing. Very soft and silky.  My husband has noticed and commented several times how soft my skin is. I am now ordering another!

reviews.t: Leaves skin soft but not much of a fragrance
reviews.x: Okay this scrub is amazing! It leaves your skin so soft it removes all the dead skin. I do wish that the smell would last a little longer if only has a grapefruit smell when you open it. Definitely buying it again.

reviews.t: Smells great but not quite moisturizing enough for really dry hands/skin
reviews.x: This is a really nice product and it smells amazing! It just needs a little more moisturizing effect if you’re someone with really dry hands but if you already have smooth soft skin then it would be great!
This is a pretty nice scrub. I love the fresh grapefruit scent. The con: I prefer a rougher scrub that doesn't dissolve too quickly. This one didn't hold up very well and dissolved really fast.
This scrub is perfect for me. I have very dry skin and I was hesitant to purchase a salt scrub; however, with the moisturizer in it, I never feel dry. The grapefruit smell is really pleasing.

reviews.t: It's very soothing and does what it says
reviews.x: I use  it to shower it's a little heavy on the face ,keeps my skin smooth.  I dont use everyday I use the olay body wash in rotation with this overall I love it its great product.
The only reason I gave this an overall 4 stars is because I wish the scrub was just a little more fine that what it is. But the smell is amazing and it does leave my feeling soft.
This is one of my all time favorites. A real treat in the shower.I have never used scrub that made ny skin so soft and beautiful. I will absolutely buy more. Well worth the price

reviews.t: Dry, I prefer an oilier scrub, but nice scent
reviews.x: Has a nice scent, doesn’t have a fake scent. skin feels smooth after use, but it’s quite dry, almost like loose large salt crystals, I prefer an oilier salt scrub
I know everyone has different skin types, but this didn’t work well with mine. The scent is great, but it didn’t leave my skin as soft as I would’ve liked.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the pleasant citrus/grapefruit scent, describing it as nice and not overpowering.
Reviewers commonly praise the exfoliating texture, saying it scrubs well without being painfully abrasive and leaves skin soft.
A frequent complaint is that the scrub is too dry and lacks enough oil, causing it to fall apart or crumble.
Several reviewers feel it is not worth the money due to the small amount of product for the price.
Some reviewers report irritation or allergic reactions, including one warning against it for eczema.
